scope: Phase 4 C2 directional K derivation seam
conclusion: The left/right/top/bottom enlarged-boundary K factors now match the actual one-site absorption index order to roundoff. This removes a major source of guessed Kronecker ordering before a dual projector is attempted.
limitations: The map describes how a known explicit virtual gauge acts; it does not infer a canonical gauge from an arbitrary tensor.
A covariant truncation still needs a dual projector update using these factors and an independent discarded-weight/transfer-gap gate.
next_action: use the directional K factors in a reference dual-projector absorption and compare physical observables under paired gauges
